findings.title: Rich record discriminator is discarded before the generic legacy editor
findings.reproBySource: A valid Outreach list/detail response containing metadata.newsletterStageId is decoded by a z.object(...).strip() without metadata. Selection then enters the same OutreachForm and generic engagement.outreach.update writer as an ordinary record.
findings.impact: Frontend cannot discriminate the contract-supported rich record; generic editing is offered. No live record or actual persistence loss has been observed.
findings.action: Root-owned response projection must retain only the contract-backed rich discriminator; route it to a dedicated rich receiver before generic editing. Malformed/unsupported discrimination must not silently downgrade to generic editing; ordinary records retain current behavior.

findings.title: Rich stage and record URLs have no receiving flow
findings.reproBySource: Current Engagement consumes draft/session/create only. Original stage receipt points to /engagement/outreach?newsletterStage=UUID; original receiver POSTs stages/:id/open then replaces the URL with newsletter=recordId.
findings.impact: A stage receipt cannot truthfully complete the user handoff until compatible thin routes and a Modules Engagement owner exist. A stage UUID cannot be substituted for V3 session/version identity.
findings.action: Bound exact document/revision/stage receipt, validate canonical destination rather than following an arbitrary route string, and adapt original inbound URLs into current shell/owner. Explicitly resolve conflicting stage/record/session/draft parameters; scope change must discard former rich selection. Keep stage unavailable until receiver is ready.

findings.title: Generic Workspace snapshot authoring is not revisioned rich document editing
findings.reproBySource: Current strict NewsletterBody has nine flat text/href blocks. Save creates/updates a generic draft/document and snapshots it; original rich save persists name/config/design at an observed integer revision.
findings.impact: Flattening a rich design into NewsletterBody would lose contract fields; existing local presets/Undo/Redo are not rich parity.
findings.action: Use governed public types/renderer in a cohesive rich authoring owner within Modules Workspace. Keep generic flow and saved-version stage unchanged. Canonical operation decoder needs explicit wire validation coordinated by root, without a second maintained campaign model.
